text:
Aisha (PM): quick sync — we need to decide rollback policy & scope cuts for the MVP vs v1 after the acme pilot ask landed. timeline might slip by 2 weeks if we hold v1 features. thoughts?

Dan (Eng): what's the blocker from eng side? is it infra or implementation time?

Aisha (PM): mostly implementation effort + runtime perf risk for streaming + new reranking flow. also sales pushing to demo to acme next week. Claire, how hard is the demo to keep without v1 features?

Claire (Sales): we can demo core flow without v1 reranking, but ACME will call it out. acceptable as long as we have a roadmap ask and fallback behavior. they'd prefer a timeline, not a sticky promise. :thumbsup:

Priya (ProdEng): my worry: if we cut reranking now, the quality delta on long prompts will be visible. we could ship a naive rerank (CPU) as fallback to avoid showing regressions, but perf will be worse.

Mateo (SRE): infra-wise we can enable a canary with reduced throughput. if you want rollback policy, propose: canary -> monitor quality & latency for 24h -> if regressions > threshold, toggle to fallback model variant. I can wire metrics.

Jonah (Design): for the demo I can surface a banner: "beta feature — performance may vary" and highlight planned improvements in v1. keeps expectations set.

Aisha (PM): propose concrete options so we can pick:

1) Hold v1 features: ship-only MVP core, delay v1 by 2 weeks. (low infra risk, higher sales risk)
2) Ship v1 partially: include naive CPU fallback for rerank, mark as experimental. (higher perf risk, keeps sales happy)
3) Canary roll: deploy full v1 to canary w/ rollback toggle and strict latency SLOs. (operational overhead)

Which do we prefer? feel free to vote with reasons.

Dan (Eng): prefer 3) if SRE can support quick rollback. avoids delaying product and keeps audit trail.

Mateo (SRE): +1 on 3) — I can push a rollback playbook. threshold: p95 latency increase > 150ms or error rate > 1.5x baseline -> rollback. also need a dev-only KV-cache warmup window to avoid cold-start tail.

Priya (ProdEng): 3) but add quality guard: automated eval on our 200-case prompt set. if coherence drop > 3% we rollback. I can wire the eval cron to the canary pipeline.

Claire (Sales): 2) is safer for the customer relationship short-term. if 3) is on the table and SRE + ProdEng can commit to the guards above, sales will accept it for the demo.

Aisha (PM): decision check: go with 3) canary rollout + Mateo rollback thresholds + Priya quality eval + Jonah client messaging. Claire will run customer comms script. action items:

- Mateo: add rollback playbook + metrics dashboard (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- Priya: add automated eval and hook to canary pipeline (ETA: 36h)
- Jonah: design banner & demo script (ETA: today noon)
- Claire: customer-facing note + expectations (ETA: today afternoon)
- Dan: implement canary toggle + KV-cache warmup (ETA: 48h)

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/v1 -> staging at 1799992200

Aisha (PM): thanks all — we'll reconvene after canary results. tagging @dan @mateo for blockers. :eyes:
